name: Joan Hicks
tribute: For over 30 years, Joan served as CT State Chairman for USA Gymnastics, twice winning the Silver Quill award. She coached at Grossfeld's Gymnastics, Polly's School of Gymnastics, and Yale University, where the team won its first Ivy League Championship of any women's sport. The CT High School Coaches established the Joan Hicks Award for the top high school gymnast in the state each year.
